about.title: About Us
about.mission: To help individuals, small businesses, and startups harness the power of information technology — regardless of the size or complexity of their needs.
about.description: Just as a medical doctor diagnoses and treats health issues at any severity level, Schicksal provides expert guidance and hands-on support for everything from small day-to-day IT problems to large-scale digital transformation projects. Clients benefit from a single trusted partner who can advise, implement, and teach.

coreValues.title: Core Value Proposition
coreValues.desc: Schicksal offers a uniquely broad and integrated service model. Most IT service providers specialize in either development, consulting, or training; however, Schicksal delivers all three under one roof, creating a seamless experience for clients who need:
list: A website or web application built from scratch
Guidance on choosing the right technology stack or service provider
Support setting up or optimizing network infrastructure
Staff or personal training on software tools and IT best practices
Strategic advice on digital transformation and modernization
coreValues.conclusion: This integrated approach eliminates the overhead of managing multiple vendors and ensures consistency across all technology decisions.
